command: cd <fxsim tree root> && python3 -I engine/fxexport < <skill dir>/examples/05_export_fir.json
note: Output captured from this example. Absolute paths use <fxsim tree root>.

stdout.check_command: cd('<fxsim tree root>/runs/export/fir8_opt'); r = check_fir8_opt; fprintf('FXSIM_VERDICT %s\n', r.verdict)
stdout.check_batch_command: matlab -batch "cd('<fxsim tree root>/runs/export/fir8_opt'); r = check_fir8_opt; fprintf('FXSIM_VERDICT %s\n', r.verdict)"
stdout.verdicts: PASS: every sample and every compiled type equal; FAIL: a difference (first_diff says where); INCOMPLETE: every compared sample equal but something could not be compared (reason says what) -- only PASS verifies the package. The script prints one JSON line and returns it as r; the commands then print 'FXSIM_VERDICT <verdict>'. Read that line: the process status can be 0 after a failed model check on macOS with MATLAB R2026b
